system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You foresee victory in the movements of your enemies, even without the Sharingan.

As a bonus action, you can initiate your Crimson Aura, radiating a pulsing aura of chakra, radiating outwards from you in a 20-foot radius, centered on you. You can maintain this Crimson Aura for 1 minute, after which you cannot activate your aura until you complete a long rest.

While your aura is active you gain the following benefits;

Exploit Opening. Creatures that make attacks while in your aura, triggers attacks of opportunities from you. The first attack of opportunity you make against a creature, per round doesn’t consume your reaction.

Scan the Perimeter. Creatures that begin or end their turn within this radius, reveal themselves to you. You become aware of one statistic from a hostile creature between their AC, one saving throw bonus of your choice, or one special ability, attack or trait the creature has, that is unique to it.

Redirection. Once per turn, when a hostile creature you can see declares an attack against you while another hostile creature is within your aura, you can spend your reaction to force another hostile creature within your aura to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being forced to interpose the attack on a failed save.
